elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other party’s employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly prohibits both parties, including Customer, from directly soliciting covered employees.

elements.element: The non-solicitation obligation is mutual and binds both parties.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies to “neither party” and also requires each party not to permit its affiliates to engage in the prohibited solicitation.

elements.element: The restriction applies only to solicitation for employment.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is limited to “directly solicit for employment.”

elements.element: Covered personnel are limited to employees of the other party who were directly involved in providing the services.
elements.evidence: The clause covers only an employee of the other party “who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.”

elements.element: The restriction applies during each covered individual’s involvement in the services and for no more than 12 months after that involvement ends.
elements.evidence: Although the clause includes a 12-month period following the end of an individual’s involvement, it also applies throughout the entire Agreement term. If involvement ends more than 12 months before the Agreement terminates, the restriction may continue for the rest of the term, exceeding the permitted individual-based period.

elements.element: General advertisements and other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party’s personnel are excluded.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly excludes “general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party’s personnel.”

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by individuals are excluded.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly excludes “any unsolicited approach by an individual.”

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The clause states that it “does not restrict either party from hiring any person,” and the operative restriction addresses solicitation rather than hiring.

result.reason: The redline largely implements the fallback by creating a mutual, targeted non-solicit with the required carve-outs and no hiring prohibition. However, retaining the restriction “During the term” can extend it beyond 12 months after an individual’s involvement ends. Because that duration element is not met, neither the preferred nor fallback position is fully satisfied. The redline does not alter unrelated commercial terms, but the conflicting aggregate-term and individual-involvement timing formulation materially reduces drafting precision.
